title: Place Value: Hundreds, Tens and Ones
seo_title: Grade 3 Place Value Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Recognise the place value of digits in whole numbers to at least 3-digit numbers; decompose 3-digit numbers into multiples of hundreds, tens and ones (expanded notation).
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 3 maths worksheets: hundreds, tens and ones, value of a digit, expanded notation, and 10 or 100 more or less. 100 questions with memos.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • In 482, the 4 means 400, the 8 means 80 and the 2 means 2.
  • 482 = 400 + 80 + 2.
  • A zero holds a place: in 407 there are no tens.
  • 10 more changes the tens digit; 100 more changes the hundreds digit.

Examples

Example

6 hundreds, 0 tens, 9 ones

600 + 9

Answer: 609

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Digit or valueThe 4 in 482 is worth 400.
Missing zero4 hundreds and 7 ones is 407.
The wrong place100 more changes the hundreds.

faq.a: Grade R to Grade 3 in South African schools. Grade 3 is the last year; learners are about 8 to 9 years old.

faq.q: What place value is in Grade 3?
faq.a: Hundreds, tens and ones for numbers to 999.

items.e: A big square is 100, a rod is 10 and a small cube is 1. 5 hundreds, 4 tens and 3 ones: 500 + 40 + 3 = 543.
A big square is 100, a rod is 10 and a small cube is 1. 4 hundreds, 3 tens and 9 ones: 400 + 30 + 9 = 439.
A big square is 1 hundred. A rod is 1 ten. A small cube is 1 one. Count each kind: 4 hundreds, 3 tens, 2 ones. The number is 432.

items.q: What number do the blocks show?
items.e: A big square is 100, a rod is 10 and a small cube is 1. 2 hundreds, 0 tens and 3 ones: 200 + 3 = 203. There are no tens, so write 0 in the tens place.

items.q: What number do the place value counters show?
items.e: Count the counters in each box. 5 hundreds, 7 tens and 1 one: 500 + 70 + 1 = 571.

items.q: In 619, which digit is in the tens place?
items.e: 619 has 6 hundreds, 1 ten, 9 ones. The tens digit is 1.
A big square is 100, a rod is 10 and a small cube is 1. 3 hundreds, 4 tens and 8 ones: 300 + 40 + 8 = 348.

items.q: Which matches the blocks?
items.e: A big square is 1 hundred. A rod is 1 ten. A small cube is 1 one. Count each kind: 1 hundred, 2 tens, 6 ones. The number is 126.
A big square is 100, a rod is 10 and a small cube is 1. 4 hundreds, 2 tens and 0 ones: 400 + 20 = 420. There are no ones, so write 0 in the ones place.

items.q: In 762, which digit is in the hundreds place?
items.e: 762 has 7 hundreds, 6 tens, 2 ones. The hundreds digit is 7.

items.q: What number do the place value counters show?
items.e: Count the counters in each box. 3 hundreds, 2 tens and 0 ones: 300 + 20 = 320. There are no ones, so write 0 in the ones place.
A big square is 100, a rod is 10 and a small cube is 1. 3 hundreds, 0 tens and 8 ones: 300 + 8 = 308. There are no tens, so write 0 in the tens place.
A big square is 100, a rod is 10 and a small cube is 1. 2 hundreds, 1 ten and 5 ones: 200 + 10 + 5 = 215.
A big square is 100, a rod is 10 and a small cube is 1. 3 hundreds, 4 tens and 6 ones: 300 + 40 + 6 = 346.
A big square is 1 hundred. A rod is 1 ten. A small cube is 1 one. Count each kind: 1 hundred, 5 tens, 3 ones. The number is 153.
A big square is 100, a rod is 10 and a small cube is 1. 3 hundreds, 0 tens and 7 ones: 300 + 7 = 307. There are no tens, so write 0 in the tens place.

items.q: What number do the place value counters show?
items.e: Count the counters in each box. 5 hundreds, 9 tens and 4 ones: 500 + 90 + 4 = 594.

items.q: In 497, which digit is in the tens place?
items.e: 497 has 4 hundreds, 9 tens, 7 ones. The tens digit is 9.
A big square is 100, a rod is 10 and a small cube is 1. 5 hundreds, 1 ten and 7 ones: 500 + 10 + 7 = 517.
A big square is 1 hundred. A rod is 1 ten. A small cube is 1 one. Count each kind: 3 hundreds, 6 tens, 9 ones. The number is 369.

items.q: Which is the same as 680?
items.e: 680 = 6 hundreds, 8 tens and 0 ones: 600 + 80.

items.q: Which is the same as 691?
items.e: 691 = 6 hundreds, 9 tens and 1 one: 600 + 90 + 1.

items.q: Which is the same as 736?
items.e: 736 = 7 hundreds, 3 tens and 6 ones: 700 + 30 + 6.

items.q: Which number has 3 hundreds, 1 ten and 6 ones?
What is the value of the digit 3 in 345?
items.e: The 3 is in the hundreds place, so it is worth 300.

items.q: Which is the same as 989?
items.e: 989 = 9 hundreds, 8 tens and 9 ones: 900 + 80 + 9.

items.q: Which number has 3 hundreds, 5 tens and 2 ones?
Which number has 1 hundreds, 6 tens and 4 ones?
Which number has 4 hundreds, 1 ten and 9 ones?
Which number has 3 hundreds, 7 tens and 8 ones?
Which is the same as 134?
items.e: 134 = 1 hundreds, 3 tens and 4 ones: 100 + 30 + 4.

items.q: Which is the same as 415?
items.e: 415 = 4 hundreds, 1 ten and 5 ones: 400 + 10 + 5.

items.q: What is the value of the digit 3 in 304?
items.e: The 3 is in the hundreds place, so it is worth 300.

items.q: Which number has 9 hundreds, 3 tens and 1 one?
Which number has 7 hundreds, 1 ten and 5 ones?
Which number has 8 hundreds, 3 tens and 4 ones?
Which is the same as 456?
items.e: 456 = 4 hundreds, 5 tens and 6 ones: 400 + 50 + 6.

items.q: Which number has 9 hundreds, 2 tens and 6 ones?
Which number has 8 hundreds, 8 tens and 6 ones?
Which is the same as 565?
items.e: 565 = 5 hundreds, 6 tens and 5 ones: 500 + 60 + 5.

items.q: What is the value of the digit 8 in 862?
items.e: The 8 is in the hundreds place, so it is worth 800.

items.q: What is the value of the digit 2 in 259?
items.e: The 2 is in the hundreds place, so it is worth 200.

items.q: What is the value of the digit 3 in 354?
items.e: The 3 is in the hundreds place, so it is worth 300.

items.q: Which is the same as 231?
items.e: 231 = 2 hundreds, 3 tens and 1 one: 200 + 30 + 1.

items.q: What is the value of the digit 4 in 442?
items.e: The 4 is in the hundreds place, so it is worth 400.

items.q: Which number has 4 hundreds, 5 tens and 6 ones?
Which number has 2 hundreds, 0 tens and 7 ones?
Which is the same as 650?
items.e: 650 = 6 hundreds, 5 tens and 0 ones: 600 + 50.

items.q: Which number has 5 hundreds, 0 tens and 6 ones?
Which number has 7 hundreds, 0 tens and 4 ones?
Which number has 8 hundreds, 0 tens and 5 ones?
Which number has 2 hundreds, 5 tens and 7 ones?
Which is the same as 491?
items.e: 491 = 4 hundreds, 9 tens and 1 one: 400 + 90 + 1.

items.q: Which is the same as 580?
items.e: 580 = 5 hundreds, 8 tens and 0 ones: 500 + 80.

items.q: Which number has 6 hundreds, 7 tens and 1 one?
Which is the same as 380?
items.e: 380 = 3 hundreds, 8 tens and 0 ones: 300 + 80.

items.q: Which is the same as 281?
items.e: 281 = 2 hundreds, 8 tens and 1 one: 200 + 80 + 1.

items.q: Which is the same as 689?
items.e: 689 = 6 hundreds, 8 tens and 9 ones: 600 + 80 + 9.

items.q: Which is the same as 292?
items.e: 292 = 2 hundreds, 9 tens and 2 ones: 200 + 90 + 2.

items.q: What is the value of the digit 3 in 306?
items.e: The 3 is in the hundreds place, so it is worth 300.

items.q: What is 10 more than 347?
items.e: 10 more than 347: only the tens digit changes. 347 + 10 = 357.

items.q: What is 100 more than 462?
items.e: 100 more than 462: only the hundreds digit changes. 462 + 100 = 562.

items.q: Count in 4s: 20, 24, 28, 32, ? What comes next?
items.e: Each number is 4 more than the one before. 32 + 4 = 36.

items.q: Count in 50s: 150, 200, 250, 300, ? What comes next?
items.e: Each number is 50 more than the one before. 300 + 50 = 350.

items.q: What is 10 less than 586?
items.e: 10 less than 586: only the tens digit changes. 586 − 10 = 576.

items.q: What is 100 less than 618?
items.e: 100 less than 618: only the hundreds digit changes. 618 − 100 = 518.

items.q: Count in 8s: 24, 32, 40, 48, ? What comes next?
items.e: Each number is 8 more than the one before. 48 + 8 = 56.

items.q: Count in 100s: 340, 440, 540, 640, ? What comes next?
items.e: Each number is 100 more than the one before. 640 + 100 = 740. Only the hundreds digit changes.

items.q: Which number would you say when counting in 4s from 0?
items.e: 7 × 4 = 28, so you say 28 when counting in 4s: 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28. 26, 18 and 34 are in the 2 times table, but not the 4 times table.

items.q: What is 10 more than 295?
items.e: 10 more than 295: change the tens digit. 295 + 10 = 305. 9 tens and 1 more ten make 10 tens = 1 hundred, so the hundreds digit goes up too.

items.q: Count in 4s: 12, 16, ☐, 24, 28. What number goes in the box?
items.e: The numbers go up by 4 each time. 16 + 4 = 20. Check: 20 + 4 = 24.

items.q: What is 10 less than 503?
items.e: 10 less than 503: change the tens digit. 503 − 10 = 493. There are 0 tens, so take 1 ten from the hundreds: 5 hundreds → 4 hundreds and 9 tens.

items.q: Count back in 50s: 500, 450, 400, 350, ? What comes next?
items.e: Each number is 50 less than the one before. 350 − 50 = 300.

items.q: Which number would you say when counting in 8s from 0?
items.e: 8 × 8 = 64. 68 is in the 4 times table but not the 8 times table. 54 and 58 end in 4 and 8 but are not multiples of 8.

items.q: What is 100 less than 140?
items.e: 100 less than 140: change the hundreds digit. 140 − 100 = 40. 1 hundred take away 1 hundred leaves 0 hundreds, so the answer has only 2 digits.

items.q: Count in 8s: 40, 48, ☐, 64, 72. What number goes in the box?
items.e: The numbers go up by 8 each time. 48 + 8 = 56. Check: 56 + 8 = 64.

items.q: What number is 2 more than 982?
items.e: Count on 2 from 982: 984.

items.q: What number is 100 more than 400?
items.e: Count on 100 from 400: 500.

items.q: What number is 2 more than 278?
items.e: Count on 2 from 278: 280.

items.q: What number is 100 more than 600?
items.e: Count on 100 from 600: 700.

items.q: Which is true?
items.e: Compare from the left. The digits are the same until the tens: 5 tens is more than 2 tens. So 352 > 325.

items.q: Which number is the greatest?
items.e: Compare from the left. The digits are the same until the tens: 4 tens is more than 2 tens. So 742 > 724. 742 is the greatest.

items.q: Which number is the smallest?
items.e: Compare from the left. The digits are the same until the tens: 6 tens is more than 5 tens. So 365 > 356. 356 is the smallest.

items.q: Put 504, 450, 540 in order from smallest to greatest.
items.e: Compare from the left. 450 < 504 (hundreds: 4 < 5). 504 < 540 (tens: 0 < 4). So the order is 450, 504, 540.

items.q: Which number is between 450 and 500?
items.e: A number between 450 and 500 is greater than 450 and less than 500. 486 > 450 and 486 < 500, so 486 is between them.

items.q: What number does the arrow point to?
items.e: From 400 to 500 there are 10 jumps, so each mark is 10, not 1. The arrow is 3 marks after 400: 400 + 30 = 430.

items.q: Put 263, 326, 236 in order from smallest to greatest.
items.e: Compare from the left. 236 < 263 (tens: 3 < 6). 263 < 326 (hundreds: 2 < 3). So the order is 236, 263, 326.

items.q: Estimate the number the arrow points to.
items.e: Each mark is 100. The arrow is halfway between 800 and 900. Halfway between them is 850.

items.q: Which number is between 700 and 800?
items.e: A number between 700 and 800 is greater than 700 and less than 800. 790 > 700 and 790 < 800, so 790 is between them.

items.q: What number does the arrow point to?
items.e: From 700 to 800 there are 10 jumps, so each mark is 10, not 1. The arrow is 6 marks after 700: 700 + 60 = 760.

items.q: Four children counted the pages they read this term. Kagiso: 389; Anika: 398; Sarah: 419; Chloe: 401. Who read the most pages?
items.e: Compare the hundreds first. 419 and 401 have 4 hundreds; 389 and 398 have only 3. Then the tens: 1 ten > 0 tens, so 419 is the greatest. Sarah read the most. Do not just look at the last digit.

items.q: Use the digits 7, 2 and 5 once each. What is the greatest number you can make?
items.e: Put the biggest digit in the hundreds place, then the next biggest: 7, 5, 2. The greatest number is 752.

items.q: The school library has 590 books. It buys 10 new books. How many books does it have now?
items.e: 9 tens + 1 ten = 10 tens = 1 hundred. So 5 hundreds become 6 hundreds and there are 0 tens: 590 + 10 = 600.

items.q: The school kitchen cooked 245 school dinners on Monday. On Tuesday it cooked 10 more. How many dinners did it cook on Tuesday?
items.e: 10 more: only the tens digit changes. 4 tens → 5 tens. 245 + 10 = 255.

items.q: Use the digits 0, 4 and 9 once each. What is the smallest 3-digit number you can make?
items.e: 0 cannot go in the hundreds place, or it would be a 2-digit number. Use the next smallest digit, 4. Then put 0 in the tens and 9 in the ones: 409.

items.q: There are 310 chairs in the school hall. 10 chairs are taken away to be mended. How many chairs are left?
items.e: 10 less: 1 ten → 0 tens. 310 − 10 = 300. The hundreds stay the same.

items.q: Siyabonga counts in 4s from 0: 4, 8, 12, … What is the 10th number he says?
Zinhle scores 380 points in a game. Fatima scores 100 points fewer. How many points does Fatima score?
items.e: 100 fewer: only the hundreds digit changes. 3 hundreds → 2 hundreds. 380 − 100 = 280.

items.q: Four classes collected bottle tops for recycling. Class 3A: 506; Class 3B: 560; Class 3C: 650; Class 3D: 605. Which class collected the fewest?
items.e: Compare the hundreds: 506 and 560 have 5 hundreds. Then the tens: 0 tens < 6 tens, so 506 is the smallest. Class 3A collected the fewest.

items.q: Stickers come in packs of 100, strips of 10 and single stickers. Ofentse has 4 packs, 6 strips and 3 single stickers. How many stickers does she have?
